reading.title: Should children use screens before bed?
reading.text: There is growing evidence that screens disturb children's sleep. Blue light, which is visible to the eye but hard to notice, tells the brain that it is still daytime. Paediatricians recommend that young children should be supervised when they use tablets and that parents provide a screen-free hour before bedtime. Some governments have revised their health advice to include these points. Researchers have a simple vision: a bedroom where books, not phones, are the last thing a child sees at night.
